summary: News Corp filed an 8-K disclosing daily repurchase transactions under its $1 billion stock buyback program, as required by ASX rules. The program authorizes open-market repurchases of Class A and Class B common stock; no fixed price, share count, or expiration date was stated. The filing is procedural—no board recommendation or advisor named. The company notes that repurchases depend on market conditions, securities laws, and alternative investments. What to watch: pace of buyback execution and any volume limitations due to ASX liquidity thresholds; no risk-arb angle as this is a routine capital return disclosure.
